source.content: @isTest private class SchemaDescribeEnumsFixtureTest { @isTest static void describesEnumContracts() { List<Schema.DisplayType> displayTypes = Schema.DisplayType.values(); System.assertEquals(30, displayTypes.size()); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.ADDRESS, displayTypes.get(0)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.ANYTYPE, displayTypes.get(1)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.BASE64, displayTypes.get(2)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.CURRENCY, displayTypes.get(6)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.DATACATEGORYGROUPREFERENCE, displayTypes.get(7)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.DATE, displayTypes.get(8)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.DATETIME, displayTypes.get(9)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.DOUBLE, displayTypes.get(10)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.EMAIL, displayTypes.get(11)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.ENCRYPTEDSTRING, displayTypes.get(12)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.FLOATARRAY, displayTypes.get(13)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.ID, displayTypes.get(14)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.INTEGER, displayTypes.get(15)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.JSON, displayTypes.get(16)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.LOCATION, displayTypes.get(17)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.LONG, displayTypes.get(18)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.MULTIPICKLIST, displayTypes.get(19)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.PERCENT, displayTypes.get(20)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.PHONE, displayTypes.get(21)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.PICKLIST, displayTypes.get(22)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.REFERENCE, displayTypes.get(23)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.SOBJECT, displayTypes.get(24)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.STRING, displayTypes.get(25)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.TEXTAREA, displayTypes.get(26)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.TEXTARRAY, displayTypes.get(27)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.TIME, displayTypes.get(28)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.URL, displayTypes.get(29)); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.STRING, Schema.DisplayType.valueOf('STRING')); System.assertEquals(25, Schema.DisplayType.STRING.ordinal()); System.assert(Schema.DisplayType.STRING.equals(Schema.DisplayType.valueOf('STRING'))); System.assertEquals(Schema.DisplayType.STRING.hashCode(), Schema.DisplayType.valueOf('STRING').hashCode()); List<Schema.FieldDescribeOptions> fieldOptions = Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.values(); System.assertEquals(2, fieldOptions.size()); System.assertEquals(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.DEFAULT, fieldOptions.get(0)); System.assertEquals(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.FULL_DESCRIBE, fieldOptions.get(1)); System.assertEquals(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.FULL_DESCRIBE, Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.valueOf('FULL_DESCRIBE')); System.assertEquals(1, Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.FULL_DESCRIBE.ordinal()); System.assert(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.DEFAULT.equals(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.valueOf('DEFAULT'))); System.assertEquals(Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.DEFAULT.hashCode(), Schema.FieldDescribeOptions.valueOf('DEFAULT').hashCode()); List<Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions> objectOptions = Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.values(); System.assertEquals(3, objectOptions.size()); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.DEFAULT, objectOptions.get(0)); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.DEFERRED, objectOptions.get(1)); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL, objectOptions.get(2)); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL, Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.valueOf('FULL')); System.assertEquals(2, Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL.ordinal()); System.assert(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL.equals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.valueOf('FULL'))); System.assertEquals(Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.FULL.hashCode(), Schema.SObjectDescribeOptions.valueOf('FULL').hashCode()); } }
